page.overview:
Who is Anark von Carstein?

A particularly brutal and dangerous Blood Knight, Anark von Carstein was perhaps the most ambitious vampire of Mannfred's get still surviving. He served as Grandmaster of the Drakenhof Templars, the greatest Blood Knights outside of the infamous Blood Keep itself.

When Erikan Crowfiend refused Elize von Carstein's offer to take on the family name, she instead found a new blood-son, lover and champion in Anark. The hulking warrior gladly accepted the title of Von Carstein, rising high in the ranks of the Drakenhof Templars.

At the beginning of the End Times Anark had been fighting in the Border Princes, leading an army of the dead on behalf of one petty warlord or another. He was large even for a Blood Knight, built for war and clad in dark armour composed of serrated plates and swooping, sharp curves. Those that saw him knew he had seen his share of battle, judging by the dents and scratches that had marked said armour...

Upon his return to Sylvania, Anark was set at Arkhan's side by his father-in-darkness. His chief mission was to ensure that the Liche was not destroyed until after Alkanash was recovered. Anark entirely understood Mannfred's wishes. He would safeguard Arkhan during the Bretonnian campaign – beyond that, it would depend very much on whether or not the liche had outlived his usefulness to the von Carsteins.
